features.name: Compress Text
features.description: Compresses the deterministic 256 KiB repetitive text corpus at the codec's own fastest level.

features.name: Compress Text Max Effort
features.description: Compresses the same 256 KiB text corpus at the codec's own maximum general-purpose level, showing what the extra effort costs.

features.name: Compress Incompressible
features.description: Compresses the deterministic 256 KiB random corpus, where no codec can win by finding redundancy.

features.name: Decompress Text
features.description: Decompresses a payload produced beforehand, so only the decoder is measured.

features.name: Decompress Incompressible
features.description: Decompresses a pre-made payload whose content is random, so the decoder cannot expand quickly by copying runs.

features.name: Round Trip Small
features.description: Compresses and decompresses a 1 KiB payload, the shape most individual messages take.
